question: What will come next: Z, X, V, T, R, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce5fa27716a3719c9e0d712a0ae52c8aca8bdaff1f92282d77a294281afad90d.png] **

Z - 2 = X

X - 2 = V

V - 2 = T

T - 2 = R

R - 2 = P

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3**”.
